query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN family IS NOT NULL AND family != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_family,
  SUM(CASE WHEN genus IS NOT NULL AND genus != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_genus,
  SUM(CASE WHEN latin_name IS NOT NULL AND latin_name != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_latin_name
FROM plants;
